[[File:Alkaline aeronautic fuel cell.png|thumbnail|An alkaline fuel cell installed in NASA spacecrafts to generate electricity]]
'''Fuel cells''' produce electricity by separating a combustion reaction into two half-reactions, made to happen at two separate '''electrodes''' submerged in an [[electrolyte]], producing an electric current in the process.

== History ==

* [[Grove's fuel cell]]

== Advantages ==

=== Less environmental impact ===

* Negligible air pollution
* Quiet

=== Reliability ===

* Very few moving parts

=== Cost-efficiency ===

* Low maintenance cost
* High efficiency (80%+, compared to 40% for traditional [[internal combustion engine]]s)
* Constant efficiency at low-load
* Flexible output with fast adjustment

== Application ==

[[File:Fuel cell car schema.png|thumbnail|Schema of a fuel cell car]]
[[File:Space shuttle fuel cell.png|thumbnail|Installing a PEM fuel cell in a Gemini 7 spacecraft]]
* Automobile propulsion
* Electricity generation in spacecrafts
